plan.why: Its FastAPI server is small, so llocal rewrites it in Go on llocal's kit. A Go server starts in a moment and needs little memory, so the app is quick and can sleep when nobody is using it.
found: An app with its own FastAPI server.
5 server routes, like GET /api/items, POST /api/items, GET /api/items/{item_id} and 2 more.
A PostgreSQL database, with 1 table: items.
People upload files, kept by its server.

left.text: Its data is in PostgreSQL (1 table) and moves into one SQLite file beside the app.
Its FastAPI server (5 routes in 5 files, 2 KB) is rewritten in Go on llocal's kit.
1 timed job moves to llocal's timetable: apps sleep when nobody uses them, which would stop a timer inside the app.
Files people upload are kept by its server, and move into the app's own storage on llocal.
It has no llocal.json yet: the short file that tells llocal how to build and start it.

changes.text: The PostgreSQL data moves into one SQLite file on llocal, copied over once.
changes.detail: SQLite sits right next to the app, so it is fast, it is backed up with the app, and only people who can open the app reach the data.

changes.text: The FastAPI server is rewritten in Go on llocal's kit, answering at the same addresses.
changes.detail: A Go server starts in a moment and needs little memory, so the app is quick and can sleep when nobody is using it.

changes.text: Timed jobs run on llocal's timetable instead of a timer inside the app.
changes.detail: Apps sleep when nobody is using them, which would stop a timer.
They are kept and backed up with the app.
